name: Java (Maven and Gradle)
description: Reads deployed Java applications (JAR, WAR and EAR files, including the libraries bundled inside them), Gradle lockfiles (exact versions, including transitive dependencies), Maven pom.xml files (direct dependencies, with properties, dependencyManagement and parent poms in the same repository) and build.gradle coordinates.
known_limitations: Libraries bundled without Maven metadata (no META-INF/maven/.../pom.properties) are counted but not identified
pom.xml lists direct dependencies only; for transitive ones enable Gradle dependency locking or import a CycloneDX SBOM (cyclonedx-maven-plugin)
Versions inherited from a parent or BOM outside the repository cannot be resolved and are reported as partial coverage
build.gradle is read only for literal group:name:version strings; enable dependency locking for exact versions
